description: A long white tray sits on the table with a dark rectangular board inside it, and two small plastic bags of game pieces are nearby, along with a chess box lid. The left hand steadies the tray while the right hand places the dark board flat into the tray, then the left hand drops in a bag of dark pieces and the right hand adds a bag of yellow pieces; finally both hands bring the chess box lid down and slide it into place to close the set.
